morphology.pattern_note: 按整词记忆，不拆成 kar- 与 -pet。词典标注 karpét，e 为 /e/，不是央元音 /ə/；berkarpet 由 ber- 直接接 karpet 构成。

word_family.gloss: 多张或多种地毯；整词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 地毯；铺设于地面的织物覆盖物。
senses.en_definition: A textile covering laid on a floor; a carpet or rug.
senses.nuances: 可指独立铺放的地毯或铺设的地毯材料，具体范围由语境决定；不必然指祈祷毯，祈祷毯通常称 sejadah。DBP 也收录 berkarpet，意为铺有地毯。[DBP：karpet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=karpet)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan akan menggantikan karpet di bilik mesyuarat pada hujung minggu ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理方将于本周末更换会议室的地毯。
dual_scenarios.en: Management will replace the carpet in the meeting room this weekend.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Karpet kat ruang tamu tu dah kering ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah karpet di ruang tamu itu sudah kering?
dual_scenarios.en: Has the living room carpet dried yet?

etymology.historical_story: Karpet closely resembles English carpet, and Cambridge gives karpet as its Malay equivalent. That correspondence is useful for learning, although it does not by itself establish the historical borrowing route. Within Malay, the word behaves as an independent base: DBP records berkarpet for having a carpet. The familiar object therefore offers a simple example of Malay affixation around an intact base. [Cambridge: carpet](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/carpet); [DBP: karpet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=karpet)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 carpet 与 karpet 并排记：看到铺在脚下的地毯，就读 kar-pet；第二音节的 e 要读清楚。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于常见中性家居用语。进入他人住宅或清真寺的铺毯区域前，应留意脱鞋标识及主人的安排。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要把所有地毯都称为 sejadah；后者特指祈祷用毯。拜访时避免穿脏鞋踩地毯，是否脱鞋以场所规定与主人示意为准。
